Den här sidan lades till efter att alla: This page was added after everyone had signed, and then the whole file was sealed with an electronic seal (PAdES). The seal shows that the file has not changed since it was sealed and with which certificate it was sealed. It shows who is behind the certificate only if the certificate was issued by an issuer the PDF reader trusts. It is not the signers' signature: each signature is a simple electronic signature. The document that was signed is kept unchanged as the first version in the file, and the checksum above applies to that version. The level of the seal and any timestamp are shown in the PDF reader's signature panel. The full signing record (evidence) for each signature is held by the sender.

Stämpeln gjordes med certifikatet för de: The seal was made with the certificate of the NONOX installation the sender uses. Whoever runs the installation does not attest to the document's content.
En sammanställning för den som får en ko: A summary for those who receive a copy. Each signature is a simple electronic signature. The signers filled in fields in the document, so the file you received is the document with their values filled in and has a different checksum. The document that was sent is kept unchanged as the first version in the file, and the checksum above applies to that version. The full signing record (evidence) for each signature is held by the sender.

Förseglingen får en tidsstämpel från en: The seal gets a timestamp from a timestamp server (PAdES B-T). If no server answers, the document is sealed without a timestamp (PAdES B-B) when the wait is over, by default one hour, and you get a notice.
Namnet i certifikatet stämmer inte med f: The name in the certificate does not match the company's name or organisation number. Whoever opens the document sees the name in the certificate, and NONOX does not verify who is behind it. Check that it is the company's own certificate.
